## Summary

Describe the change and the user workflow it affects.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant Rust/native tests pass, or I explain why they were not run.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior, support or packaging changed.
- [ ] I identified new third-party dependencies/assets, their provenance, licenses and notices.
- [ ] Each contributed commit has a `Signed-off-by:` DCO trailer.
- [ ] I considered each affected platform: macOS (ARM64/x64), Windows (x64/ARM64), Linux (x64/ARM64).

## Platform results and limits

List actual hosts and tests run. CI validation is separate from personal testing.
